subject: CloudMesh referral — ApexHealth demo availability
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@cloudmesh.io>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: ApexHealth (referral) — Jonah Price

Diego,

Quick intro — Jonah Price at ApexHealth (CC'd below) is evaluating options for inference serving for clinical note summarization. CloudMesh recommended Redwood based on the predictable latency and our recent Dedicated work. Jonah signed up on the self-serve flow and asked for a product walk-through + how Redwood would integrate with their SI plan.

A few notes from our side:
- ApexHealth will need HIPAA-adjacent controls and an on-prem pilot later this year.
- Primary stakeholders: Jonah (AML lead), CISO (TBD).
- CloudMesh will be present on the call to cover integration steps.

Would you take the intro and propose 2–3 slots? I put Marissa on CC in case you want manager backup for any pricing/commitment questions.

Attachment: referral_context.txt (short notes)

Camila Reyes
Partner Success Manager | CloudMesh
camila.reyes@cloudmesh.io

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonah Price <jonah.price@apexhealth.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@cloudmesh.io>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: ApexHealth (referral) — Jonah Price

Hi Jonah — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks Camila for the intro.

Congrats on getting started with the self-serve signup. I pulled together a short 30-min demo that covers: platform overview, latency/cost controls, and how CloudMesh integration typically looks.

Proposed slots (Pacific / converted to your local time below — please confirm):
- Tue 16 Jun, 10:00 AM PDT / 1:00 PM EDT (30 min)
- Tue 16 Jun, 2:00 PM PDT / 5:00 PM EDT (30 min)
- Wed 17 Jun, 9:00 AM PDT / 12:00 PM EDT (30 min)

If none of these work, let me know a couple mornings next week and I’ll re-propose. Also, would you like CloudMesh to present the integration plan on the call? Camila is on CC.

I attached a brief we usually share before demos so you can skim agenda and technical notes.

Attachment: redwood-demo-brief.pdf

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
SDR | Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0197

Diego — thanks for the quick follow-up. I’m in ET (based in NYC) and Tuesday afternoon at 5:00 PM ET will be tight — we have a board sync. Wednesday 12:00 PM ET (your Wed 9am PDT) is likely the best option.

A couple of asks from my side:
- Could you share a 1-page agenda ahead of time?
- Will CloudMesh be on the call to discuss integration touchpoints? We want the SI up to speed so the pilot plan is actionable.

Also, we have a short compliance questionnaire — I can share that after the demo but if there’s an existing docs pack (SOC/Security) it would be helpful.
